message: 二人のサムライ
What kind of training should we do to get stronger? Not just building individual strength, but how do we fight in coordination? I don't even have a clue...
I leave the Student Council room and head toward the new school building, aiming for Class 2-A, though my feet feel heavy.

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo, why're you going all the way back to the classroom after school?」

name: Synn
message: 「They keep soccer balls and volleyballs there for playing during breaks. I want to borrow them and practice with everyone」

name: Synn
message: 「If we do that, don't you think we could learn the basics of teamwork?」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's pretty questionable. Crusaders isn't a sport, y'know」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I guess so...」

name: Shio
message: 「Ah, Lord Synn. To meet you in such a place, fate truly smiles upon us」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Shio-chan. What are you doing here--」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmph!? There they are!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-S-S-Shio-chan!? It's dangerous to unsheathe a naginata in a place like this」

name: Shio
message: 「All is for the sake of growing stronger... I shall make my move!」

name: Shio
message: 「Hyaaaah!」
Shio-chan brandishes her naginata and charges down the hallway. Standing at the end of it is...

name: Shio
message: 「What!?」
Misasagi-senpai lightly flicks her folding fan, knocking Shio-chan's naginata flying out of her hands.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Asukai-han, now now, being naughty won't do, ya hear?」

name: Shio
message: 「Kuhin!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Shio-chan got beaten back so effortlessly...」
I rush over to the two of them, pick up the fallen naginata, and quickly put it away in its bag. There, now it's safe.

name: Shio
message: 「J-Just as I thought, my eyes did not deceive me!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「What's the big idea, coming at me out of nowhere like that?」

name: Shio
message: 「Lady Akane, first, please forgive my rudeness!」

name: Shio
message: 「For the sake of my training, I am searching for skilled warriors. Would it not be ideal if we trained together and became true soldiers?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, pulling a surprise attack like that isn't like you, Shio-chan.」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay! To quickly gauge an opponent's true strength, there is no other tactic than this」

name: Paqy
message: 「T-That's completely ridiculous logic」

name: Shio
message: 「No, decidedly not! Any warrior of true might would have dodged or struck back...!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Hold on just a moment. If Asukai-han's judgment is off and they turn out to be an ordinary civilian, they'll take a naginata straight to the face, you know?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「What were you planning to do then?」

name: Shio
message: 「Nngh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You hadn't thought about it?」

name: Shio
message: 「Aha, just as I surmised, Akane-dono is indeed a master of self-defense!」

name: Shio
message: 「How about we hold an inter-style match at the Budokan right away--」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Don't worry about me」
Misasagi-senpai lightly taps Shio-chan's head with a folding fan.

name: Misasagi
message: 「I can't say I don't understand how you feel, Asukai, though what you're doing is completely wrong morally」

name: Shio
message: 「O-oh? There's a sardine cloud in the sky...」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you, they're mackerel clouds」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You don't need to try and hide it. If my school's style is fine by you, I'll gladly teach you as much as you want about what it takes to grow stronger」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, much obliged!」

name: Synn
message: 「Please let me hear it too」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Hmph, looks like nobody's around. That suits me just fine. Come on over here」
Beckoned over by Misasagi-senpai, Shio-chan and I enter the empty classroom.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Mhm, mhm, it's still way too soon for Asukai-han to be getting moxa」

name: Shio
message: 「Now then, what might Yaito be?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm talking about moxibustion」

name: Shio
message: 「Wha--?! I-I-I-I just remembered an urgent matter, so if you'll excuse me!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ohoho, I won't let you get away, you know?」

name: Shio
message: 「L-Let me gooo~! Flail, flail!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misasagi-senpai? Why are you carrying Shio-chan like a kidnapper?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「From way back, this is the punishment for a naughty kid」

name: Shio
message: 「K-Kuhii~~?!」

name: Shio
message: 「Spanking my butt is way too cruel, indeed! Even though I am a high school girl so fair that even flowers blush!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「As long as you keep saying things like that, you're still just a child」

name: Shio
message: 「Kuhin, tehin」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You've got a bright future ahead of you, Asukai. There's no need to rush--you'll be able to climb as high as you want」

name: Misasagi
message: 「So make sure you remember this well」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Power without justice is impotent, and justice without power is impotent too!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see. That's pretty deep, Shio-chan」

name: Shio
message: 「S-Sir Synn, please do not look upon my shameful state」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, um, are you actually listening to what Misasagi-senpai is saying?」

name: Shio
message: 「I beg of you, please keep this matter a secret from my elder sister~」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah. Well then, I'm heading out now, so I'll leave the naginata right here, okay?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh my. I wouldn't mind at all if you stayed to see this through to the end, you know?」

name: Shio
message: 「Lady Akane, just how many times do you intend to spank my rear end!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Why, a hundred times, of course」

name: Shio
message: 「A-A huuundreeeed!?」
Returning to the hallway, I muttered Misasagi-senpai's sense of propriety over and over to myself.
What is the right principle for Everyone in the Crusaders? Once that becomes clear, we'll definitely be able to work together and grow stronger...!
